system.benefit: The character takes no penalty on @Check[skill:drive]{Drive check}s or attack rolls made when operating a surface vehicle of the selected class.
system.normal: Characters without this feat take a –4 penalty on @Check[skill:drive]{Drive check}s made to operate a surface vehicle that falls under any of these classes, and to attacks made with vehicle weapons. There is no penalty when you operate a general-purpose surface vehicle.
system.special: A character can gain this feat as many as five times. Each time the character takes the feat, he or she selects a different class of surface vehicle.
